title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
description: Standard attention computes a full N×N attention matrix in HBM (slow GPU memory), requiring O(N²) memory. FlashAttention computes attention in tiled blocks entirely in SRAM (fast on-chip memory), reducing memory to O(N) and achieving 2–4× speedup. This made training on long sequences practical and is now standard in every major LLM.
